text_block_list.text:
Summer is here, along with the
opportunity for
significant growth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер appears unbothered by
the
looming Japan Cup, but I know she's
burning with
determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We'll put that fervor to use and make
the most of
the summer camp!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
